description: Return recent coronal mass ejections (NASA DONKI) and the current Kp index. Use it to explain an aurora alert or space weather; for 'can I see the aurora from here' use aurora, which applies the latitude threshold. Live data through the Vigi-Sky API, cached 5 minutes; degrades to an explicit 'unavailable' when NASA does not answer.
name: solar
title: Solar activity and CMEs
